svg.text: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 + 12864 LCD (ST7920, serial mode) + buzzer, buttons, RTC and sensors
Check YOUR module's pin labels before powering it
Turn it until the text is dark but the background is not black.
No transistor? Join BLK to GND (always full brightness).
Plus a diode (SS14) across the buzzer: cathode to +5V.
The board's BOOT button also works as NEXT; hold SELECT for the menu.
Both modules share the same two wires. Check your module's pin order.
3V3 - LDR - GPIO2 - 10k - GND (100 nF GPIO2 to GND steadies it)
The custom PCB already includes all of this.
